posts.headline: Twelve editions of hunting the African Bald Fraud and mjwithgoldhoops just won't give the mob what it wants, climbing to 9-2 with the league's best record AND a league-high 1521.56 points.
posts.detail: A 4-average-finish pedigree said this team was supposed to be forgettable, but the scoreboard keeps saying otherwise — at some point the chase has to turn into a coronation.

posts.headline: Twelve straight editions of burying Thicks and the reigning champ is STILL the least scary 7-4 team alive, buried in points-for at 1178.5 while pretenders outscore him by hundreds.
posts.detail: One ring and a 14-14 career record don't mean much when you're propping up the points-for leaderboard from the bottom — the crown is on mute and nobody's turning up the volume.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is drowning at 2-9 with a league-worst 1141.04 points, and the 12-average-finish pedigree is proving to be destiny, not coincidence.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record was already a warning label, and this season is just the sequel nobody asked for but everybody expected.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's back-to-back-finalist résumé is now completely buried under a 3-8 record, the ugliest freefall a 20-8, 1.5-average-finish dynasty could possibly suffer.
posts.detail: This is a team that finished first or second in both prior seasons — now stuck near the Titty Committee basement with 1187.78 points, a true Dallas Cowboys-style collapse.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 8-3 with 1511.84 points and still nobody in this league is talking about triciagloston — which is exactly the problem for everyone chasing her.
posts.detail: One win off the league's best record with the third-most points in Busters Anonymous, and the silence around this team is starting to look like a strategy, not an oversight.
